datasets.name: UAV aerial imagery of the 2023 Gansu Jishishan Ms 6.2 earthquake
datasets.source: Authors' own emergency scientific survey mission
datasets.verbatim: Using a JOUAV CW-15 VTOL (Vertical Take-Off and Landing) fixed-wing UAV (Chengdu Crossbow Automation Technology Co., Ltd., Chengdu, China), we conducted aerial photography covering approximately 20 km2 of severely affected landslide zones post-earthquake

methods.name: Enhanced YOLOv8 with P2 detection head and large-tile segmentation–tile mosaicking workflow
methods.summary: The method enhances the YOLOv8 architecture by adding a high-resolution P2 detection head to improve small-target detection (4-16 pixels). It integrates this with a large-tile processing workflow that handles geocoded imagery, performs instance segmentation, and mosaics the results back into a seamless map.
methods.verbatim: this study proposes and validates an innovative methodology integrating enhanced deep learning architectures with large-tile processing strategies, featuring two core advances: (1) a critical enhancement of YOLOv8’s shallow layers via a higher-resolution P2 detection head... and (2) the development of a large-tile segmentation–tile mosaicking workflow

availability.author_statement: "The datasets generated and analyzed during the current study are available from the corresponding author on reasonable request."

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory is not referenced or linked, and the custom code for the enhanced YOLOv8 methodology is not available.
